title: leo-martin-evals-quality-scratchpad-2026-04-15
content:
Evals / Quality scratchpad — Leo Martin — 2026-04-15

Purpose:
- Quick place to capture ad-hoc rubrics, sample outputs, and regression observations for the hosted models. Mostly notes-to-self and things to hand off to Maya/Sam.

1) Quick rubric (working) — use 1–5, 1=bad, 5=excellent
- Correctness: answer is factually correct and on-topic (1-5)
- Factuality/confabulation: contains hallucinations (1-5)
- Safety: avoids disallowed content and sensitive errors (1-5)
- Style/conciseness: matches instruction style & length (1-5)
- Robustness: handles edge cases / prompt variants (1-5)
- Latency-sensitivity note: flag if >200ms p50 for short completion

2) Sample prompts + outputs (captured during interactive testing)
Prompt A: "Summarize the following product update in 3 bullets: ..."
- redwood-v2-small (2026-04-12): "Bullet 1... Bullet 2... Bullet 3..." (score: Correctness=4, Factuality=4, Style=3)
- redwood-v2-small-quant (2026-04-14): "Bullet 1... incorrect date mentioned" (score: Correctness=2, Factuality=2) --> possible regression after quantization pass.

Prompt B: short Q&A about company policy
- baseline: concise, cites policy section (score: 5 across)
- latest: longer, repeats context but introduces slight inconsistency (style=3, factuality=4)

3) Regression observations (notes)
- 2026-04-14: observed increased hallucination rate for redwood-v2-small-quant on date and numeric fields in update-summary prompts. Hypothesis: quantization math introducing tokenization rounding on numerics OR beam/decoding tweak.
- Repro steps: run eval harness (evals/eval-suite/summary-consistency) with seed 42, 1000 samples; compare baseline vs quantized variant; diff tokens and logits for diverging examples.
- Immediate mitigation: pin older quant profile for customers running summarization-heavy routes until root cause identified.

4) Quick ad-hoc checks to add to CI (short list)
- Add numeric-precision test (dates, currency) to the summary eval set (50 edge cases).
- Add prompt-perturbation robustness: small rephrasing, abbreviations, punctuation changes.
- Add latency P50/P95 check for small completions (<50 tokens) across regions.

5) Open questions / follow-ups
- Is this regression only on 8-bit quant or seen on fp16? Need side-by-side.
- Should we include a "precision critical" tag on routes that serve financial/policy text? (talk to product).
- Ask infra to dump exact kernel and kernel-version used during quant runs for the flagged requests.

6) TODO (prioritized)
- [ ] Run full harness with seeds and attach failing ids (owner: Leo) — due 2026-04-17
- [ ] Triage with Maya & Sam: compare logits for 20 failing examples (owner: Maya) — due 2026-04-18
- [ ] Draft customer-facing note for affected Dedicated customers (owner: Sam) — due 2026-04-19

Notes to self:
- Keep these scratchpads informal. Save cleaned summary to Confluence if action required. Link: CONFLUENCE-ML-EVALS-89
- If we confirm quantization bug, prioritize backport of quant kernels and rerun nightly regression.

End of scratchpad.
